project_type: Monorepo: backend/ Fastify + WebSocket + Postgres (live rooms persisted as JSON in public.live_room_snapshots), frontend/ Next.js 16 (read frontend/AGENTS.md and node_modules/next/dist/docs before Next.js code)
language: TypeScript (backend ESM, .js import suffixes); frontend TSX
build_system: backend: tsc (tsconfig.build.json); frontend: next build. Windows/PowerShell, no long-lived dev servers.
test_framework: backend vitest (backend/tests/restore.test.ts uses buildApp + StaticTokenAuthService + MemoryFc26Catalog); frontend headless Playwright .mjs tests in frontend/tests using ui-harness.mjs (restore-ui.mjs)
build_command: cd backend; npx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit  |  cd frontend; npm run typecheck; npx next build
test_command: cd backend; npx vitest run tests/restore.test.ts (then full npx vitest run)  |  frontend: node tests/restore-ui.mjs through the existing runner
verification_instructions: Backend tsc, restore tests, full vitest (known baseline: 6 skip-vote failures plus load-only timeouts). Frontend typecheck + next build + restore-ui (auction-ui, overview-ui, retention-ui, retention-overlay-ui, formations-ui failed on clean HEAD before). UTF-8 strict-decode scan of changed files (lone Latin-1 bytes broke Vercel before).
environment_constraints: Never touch the hosted DB; do not apply migrations; no migration needed. Commit locally, never push. Work in place in C:\Users\ASUS\projects\Realtime -Auction (no worktree). Run `git status` first and do not clobber unrelated changes.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing conventions; no unrequested refactors; secure by default (parameterized SQL, no user ids leaked to non-hosts).
key_patterns: Team.userId is identity; restored unclaimed teams use 'unclaimed:'+teamId sentinel (restore.claims.ts); room JSON is the persisted doc so additive optional Team fields need no migration; DomainError/requireThat for errors; engine mutates via manager.mutate; restore settings locked by RESTORE_LOCKED_SETTINGS.
